name: phase3_small_engineering_sanity_set
description: Ten manually prepared external-file workflow cases; this is not a statistically representative benchmark.
provenance_policy: No suitable external or naturally model-generated examples were present locally. Every case is explicitly labeled manually prepared and is not claimed as natural LLM output.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise a plausible nonexistent-package import.
cases.requirement: Dedent the indented word ready and expose the stripped text as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise a realistic nonexistent statistics API.
cases.requirement: Compute the arithmetic mean of 2, 5, and 8 and expose it as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise a plausible nonexistent collections class.
cases.requirement: Count letters in banana and expose the most common letter and count as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise a nonexistent pathlib method.
cases.requirement: Use pathlib to expose the suffix of report.csv as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise an incorrect but plausible keyword argument.
cases.requirement: Serialize the dictionary with keys sorted and expose the JSON string as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise a missing required API argument.
cases.requirement: Parse a JSON object containing value 7 and expose that value as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to show a functionally wrong program exposed only by its test.
cases.requirement: Find the smallest value in 7, 2, 9, and 4 and expose it as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared for Phase 3 to exercise a plausible nonexistent standard-library submodule.
cases.requirement: URL-encode the query value hello world and expose the encoded text as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared as an already-correct no-repair control.
cases.requirement: Compute the hypotenuse of a 3-4 triangle and expose it as result.

cases.provenance_detail: Prepared as an already-correct no-repair control.
cases.requirement: Parse a JSON boolean and expose it as result.
